description:
During our Fellowship Trip to Meghalaya from 23rd to 27th September, we had a wonderful flag exchange on 25th September with the Rotary Club of Shillong, at the prestigious Shillong Club, in the presence of their 2 PDGs and 1 AKS.
Our President Amit Gupta and Past President Rupen Doshi spoke about the glorious history of Bombay Pier.
IPP AKS Noopur Desai, PE Manish Agarwal, Charter member Amith Dholakia, PP Mayuri Bhasin, Suhit Jhaveri, Sunil Mehta, Ian Pereira, Viraj Kulkarni, Kallolini Gandhi and partners Neha Doshi & Rufina Fernandes added grace to the occasion.
